name: Koto
source:
A student at Central School. She's a hardworking girl.

She speaks politely to everyone and rarely concerns herself about what's "normal."

"Hmm, it's not normal! Well, what kind of place is normal!?"

[Translated from [url=https://mo-623-mo.amebaownd.com/posts/22703015]official website[/url]]
